solutions.title: Pad and scan
solutions.strategy: Left-pad the shorter string with zeros, then add aligned bits from right to left.

timeComplexity.explanation: Padding and scanning touch each input bit a constant number of times.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The padded strings and output buffer are proportional to the longer input plus any carry.

solutions.title: Two pointers without padding
solutions.strategy: Walk both strings from the end and treat missing digits as zero.

timeComplexity.explanation: The loop advances through each input string once from right to left.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The result stores at most one more bit than the longer input; no padded copies are needed.
